verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any spending cap, hard budget limit, or budget-alert feature for Cerebras Inference. The Cloud Console manages usage and billing, self-serve payment starts at $10, and rate limits exist, but these are adjacent features: none of them is a documented control that stops or alerts on runaway spend.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill
